subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from `config.patch`?
rationale: The remaining fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may touch the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so automation should not choose the product/API direction alone.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean defaults and leave gateway mutation protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only adjust progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only and reduce scary exec wording, which is smaller but still leaves users without a streaming-but-no-progress control.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the gateway mutation allowlist so agents can disable streaming, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled config path.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean defaults and leave gateway mutation protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best history signal for the Feishu Card Kit streaming config surface introduced by the related merged PR.
